outcome: Gestational weight gain (GWG) categories (below, within, or above recommended guidelines)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 1557 pregnant women from the Araraquara Cohort, Brazil, with a gestational age of 19 weeks or less at the time of data collection.
finding: Machine learning models, particularly XGBoost, can effectively predict gestational weight gain categories with reasonable accuracy, providing a valuable tool for early identification of at-risk pregnancies.
gest_age: 19 weeks or less (at the start of data collection)
